feed.speaker: Physical transformation
feed.text:
The moment your feet slip into the crimson heels, you feel it—a subtle warmth spreading across your soles. The curve of the arch presses against the rigid interior of each heel, demanding an impossible shape.

Your arches resist at first, but then something gives way beneath your skin. You can feel the bones shifting, the tendons adjusting, all drawn toward accommodating the severe upward tilt of these cursed shoes.

The sensation is intimate and strange—like watching your own body reshape itself in response to the heels' persistent demand. Your weight settles differently now, the ball of your foot bearing more load as your arches lift higher and higher into that exaggerated curve.

You stand there outside Applewood Apartments, feeling the transformation complete its first stage beneath your red-painted toes.

feed.text:
The moment your feet slip into the crimson heels, you feel it—a subtle warmth spreading across your soles. The curve of the arch presses against the rigid interior of each heel, demanding an impossible shape.

Your arches resist at first, but then something gives way beneath your skin. You can feel the bones shifting, the tendons adjusting, all drawn toward accommodating the severe upward tilt of these cursed shoes.
